messages.subject: Article about various app formats
parts:
Hi everyone -

We've noticed that there's some confusion about whether the server.R needs a call to shinyServer(), and similarly, whether ui.R needs a call to shinyUI(). Shiny app authors might also be wondering why sometimes you can use one file with shinyApp().

To help clear things up, we've posted a new article about this. In the article, we also explain what kinds of things you can give to runApp() to launch an application.

Here's the link:
  http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/app-formats.html


-Winston
